text.text: Alpha beat · 10 HzTwo soft tones, 216 Hz and 226 Hz, one in each ear.
Studies link binaural beats to lower anxiety; results depend on the frequency and how long you liste
Use headphones for binaural sounds
Ocean wavesA slow swell of surf, rising and falling about every ten seconds.
A slow, predictable rhythm gives your attention somewhere easy to rest.
Warm drone · 432 HzA warm 432 Hz drone with a soft bowl every half minute.
A steady, warm drone is easy to settle into. 432 Hz itself is not proven to be special.
Singing bowlsA low drone with a singing bowl struck every 18 seconds.
Following a long tone until it fades is a simple way to anchor your attention.
Sound for calm, sleep and focus

text.text: Alpha beat · 10 HzTwo soft tones, 216 Hz and 226 Hz, one in each ear.
Studies link binaural beats to lower anxiety; results depend on the frequency and how long you liste
Use headphones for binaural sounds
Ocean wavesA slow swell of surf, rising and falling about every ten seconds.
A slow, predictable rhythm gives your attention somewhere easy to rest.
Warm drone · 432 HzA warm 432 Hz drone with a soft bowl every half minute.
A steady, warm drone is easy to settle into. 432 Hz itself is not proven to be special.
Singing bowlsA low drone with a singing bowl struck every 18 seconds.
Following a long tone until it fades is a simple way to anchor your attention.
Sound for calm, sleep and focus
